{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool-blend blazer, tailored fit, knee-length hem, deep charcoal gray #36454F, heavy wool blend.
Champagne silk-blend blouse, relaxed collar, long sleeves to wrist, shimmering champagne gold #F7E7CE, lightweight crepe de chine.
Oatmeal ponte knit midi skirt, A-line cut, mid-calf length, soft oatmeal #D3C6B4, structured cotton-polyester blend with elastane.
Black suede ankle boots, pointed toe, low block heel, matte black #0A0A0A, soft nappa suede.
Pearl drop earrings and a simple gold cuff bracelet.
This ensemble balances the formal requirement of an upscale restaurant Christmas dinner with the warmth needed for cold autumn weather, using a textured wool blazer to add structure while keeping the silhouette elegant. The champagne blouse introduces a festive touch that complements holiday lighting without being overly loud, while the oatmeal skirt grounds the look in refined neutral tones suitable for evening gatherings. Finally, the suede ankle boots provide the necessary warmth and modest heel height appropriate for an upscale setting where comfort meets sophistication."}
